name: Glassblower
firstNightReminder: Hand out as many potions as the voting majority minus 1 divided amongst any number of players.
otherNightReminder: Hand out as many potions as the voting majority minus 1 divided amongst any number of alive players.
ability: Each night, potions equal to the voting majority minus 1 are given out.
flavor: Sometimes, the most beautiful creations are born from shattered dreams.
